preview: Interview experience for Graduate Technical Analyst role at Deutsche Bank covering online coding round, two technical rounds, professional fitness round, and HR round.
content: INTERVIEW EXPERIENCE (FTE) DEUTSCHE BANK Shruti Tambe B.Tech IT (2020-2024) Deutsche Bank visited our campus in July end 2022 to hire final year students for the role of Graduate Technical Analyst in TDI (Technology , Data and Innovation) Business Division. Eligibility Criteria CPI : 7 and above Branches: Computers, IT & EXTC No backlogs Hiring Workflow 1. Coding Round 2. Technical Interview 1 3. Technical Interview 2 4. Professional Fitness Round 5. HR round Round 1 - Online coding test (90 mins) The test was conducted on the Hackerearth platform. There were 3 coding questions and the questions were of easy to medium level difficulty. The marking scheme for the questions were 20, 50, 50 respectively. There was partial marking based on the number of test cases solved in the respective questions. 1. Power Limit Given 2 resources with powers A and B respectively. At each second, you have to select one resource out of 2 to run the software. The power of the resource at the time of selection should be greater than 1. Every second, the power of the selected resource gets reduced by 2 and the power of the unselected resource gets charged by 1. The software stops when at least one resource has 0 power. You are given integers A and B. Print the maximum number of seconds your software can run if you select the resources optimally. Function Description Complete the function PowerLimit(). This function takes the following 2 parameters A represents the power of the first resource and B represents the power of the second resource. I passed 9/10 test cases. 2.Auto Suggest Given a dictionary consisting of N words and a query word S. You need to auto suggest the best word from the dictionary that is closest to S. Two words are first compared by their Levenshtein distance to the word S. If two words have the same Levenshtein distance, then the lexicographically smaller word is given priority. Notes Levenshtein distance between two strings is defined as the minimum number of edits required to obtain one string from the other. An "edit" is defined by either an insertion of a character, a deletion of a character, or a replacement of a character. All the words and the query word S consist of lowercase alphabets only. I passed all the test cases of this question. 3.Backlink Sorting Backlinks are links from other websites to a particular web resource, and they play a crucial role in the SEO of pages. You are given N web page titles and corresponding arrays that contain the number of backlinks for each web page. The objective is to rank the web pages in descending order based on the number of backlinks they have. Note: If two or more web pages have the same number of backlinks, maintain their original order. Function description Complete the function Sorter. This function takes 2 parameters as arguments and returns the strings: WebPage: Represents an array of strings that contains the webpage titles Backlinks: Represents an array of integers that contains the backlink count. I passed all the test cases. For coding round preparation, start solving questions on gfg practice and leetcode practice as much as you can in a timely manner to build the habit of solving problems. Try solving questions using pen and paper which will even help you during the interviews to explain your approach to the interviewer. 40 people were shortlisted for the interviews. Round 2 - Technical Interview 1 (approx 45 to 50 mins) So, it was an offline interview scheduled for 9th August 2023, starting from 9:00 am at TPO Seminar Hall. In the first technical round the interviewer asked me questions section wise mentioned in my resume. Basically in this round I was asked questions from my internship experience, projects, OOPS, DBMS, OS, ML (as i had a project related to Machine Learning) and some puzzles as well. But again it will depend on the interviewer and his experience on which domain you can be asked questions about. Firstly the interview began with a warm greeting from the interviewer to make us comfortable. She asked me to introduce myself. In the introduction I mentioned my internship experience, the projects I have worked on , the hackathons that I had participated in and my areas of interest and hobbies. Be ready with your answer beforehand and practice in front of the mirror so that you don’t make any mistakes. Remember no answer is perfect so be yourself while answering any question asked. After the introduction she asked in depth questions related to my internship experience. As I interned at COE - CNDS Labs VJTI as an AI/ML research intern and the internship was focused on the NLP and cybersecurity So she did expect me to have a thorough knowledge about the domain and flow of my work.During my internship as research intern we had read the research paper and implemented it as well. She seemed satisfied with my explanation about the internship and I even told the future scope and the difficulties faced during the internship work. Even if you are doing an internship at college then do put in efforts for the project that you are working on and mention only the things that you have enough knowledge about in your resume. After that she moved on to the projects section , as i have mentioned 2 web development projects and 1 ML related projects so she asked me a few questions related to the tech stack used, what are the functionalities implemented. As one of my projects was an individual project then she asked me why I prefer an individual to which I said I wanted to explore a particular tech stack and enhance my skills. In this manner we have a brief decision about the projects as well. I tried to use the STAR (situation, tasks, actions, result) method while explaining my projects so while you are also preparing for your interview you can also follow the same method by which you can help to explain your project in detail. Then she asked why do you prefer doing a research internship at college and do you have any plans for masters ? After all this discussion she started asking me questions related to core subjects and DSA they are as follows: What do you understand from Data structures and Algorithms? What is the difference between the two? Name some of the data structures and algorithms you know. I also tried to explain them in short and gave some real life examples of those. What are the properties of stacks and queue and asked to tell some of the examples where it is used. I was asked to explain the approach and code the question based on a circular queue using an array. She asked some questions related to linked lists and asked me to tell the real life example of doubly linked lists. She asked if I am aware of graph algorithms to which I said yes and was told to name a few of them. I told the names and explained them in brief. She asked to explain the Dijkstra Algorithm in detail and where we use it. She asked if I knew where we could use it in ML. So i tried explaining how we can use it in Neural network Deep Learning So she was satisfied with the answer. She asked me if i know A* algorithm ? What is DP (Dynamic Programming) ? Why do we use it ? How to implement DP ? I tried to explain the question in detail using an example. I was then asked questions related to OOPS which include explaining all the four pillars of OOPS? Where do we use in real life and some cross questions based on the concepts of OOPS. Have a thorough understanding of OOPS concepts. She asked if I knew what an API is ? After the technical explanation she told me to explain in layman terms so I did that using an example to explain the process. She asked if I knew DBMS. Then she asked me to explain all the types of JOINS. For the explanation I used the venn diagram to explain the joins and after that she gave me two tables and told me to write all the sql joins queries for the table. She then asked an OS related question. What is Virtual memory ? I explained the concept in detail and she asked where it's been implemented and used. Puzzle: https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/puzzle-1-how-to-measure-45-minutes-using-two-identical-wires/ If you know the puzzle beforehand, first discuss with the interviewer and then give the correct answer. If you don’t know the answer then discuss all the possible approaches that come to your mind. They want to know your critical thinking ability. Lastly, we get to ask question to the interviewer So i asked the following questions to the interviewer How is her experience with the DB ? What is TDI ? What is the rotational training program? Attend the companies PPT carefully and you will get the relevant questions to ask rather than the general questions that everyone will ask. Round 3 - Technical Round 2 (Approx 45 - 50 mins) This round was mostly focused on the internship experience, projects, tech stacks and the other achievements in depth. The interviewer in this round was pretty strict and throughout the interviewer she had no expression which made me feel whether I am answering the questions satisfactorily or not.If i was stuck at any point then she helped to get to the answer. So after the interview what i learnt from my experience is not to lose hope in such a situation. We need to keep answering to the best of our abilities. Be yourself and don’t lose your confidence. This is what she wants to check during the interview. First she asked a formal question to introduce myself. After that there was an in depth decision related to my internship experience. As it was the research internship she asked me why I chose to do a research internship. The mode of the internship. Was it the individual or team project that you were working on during the internship? As my internship focused on NLP and cybersecurity. She asked what are the NLP libraries that you have used and why you choose to use them. She asked what BERT model is and have you used any pretrained model ? What is transformers. She basically asked for a very detailed explanation of whatever was mentioned in the description of the internship section. What are threats related to cybersecurity?. As during the internship duration we read the research paper and had a comparative analysis of the techniques used to which she told me to explain the difference between the two methodologies used in two different papers. As in this type of research and projects the main focus is on the datasets So she asked me like how you gathered the datasets. So again I explained the process that we followed and the sources from which we got some data.She asked me the question related to training, testing and validation set. The size of the dataset. At the end of the decision I explained the area of scope, difficulties we faced etc. You need to know the thorough understanding of your work. After the decision related to internship work She asked me if i have any plans for doing masters in future. She then moved to the project section. As I have mentioned 3 projects in the resume the first 2 were her prime focus for discussion and from the last one she asked some questions. First she told me to explain the project . The first project was Notes App, second was Cancer Prediction using SVC and third was the blog website. After that she read the description and started asking questions. How is the search functionality implemented ? Explain the CRUD operation? Why have you used mongodb? Difference between sql and nosql database. How is data stored in mongodb ? What does your database look like? Draw the diagram for it. Some questions related to bootstrap and EJS. what is a responsive website and how to make the website responsive. What is pagination and how have you implemented it ? What is Authentication? How have you implemented it ? Which dependencies have you installed to implement it ? For the second project she asked some questions related to python libraries used? What is preprocessing ? Explain the algorithm used for the prediction ? Have you deployed a project? For the third project she just asked some questions related to API. After that she asked Should we continue with some react questions to which I said yes and even mentioned that I have a basic knowledge about it. So she didn’t ask any questions related to react and moved to the next section. Then i was asked to write the SQL query : SQL Query to Find the Name of a Person Whose Name Starts with Specific Letter - GeeksforGeeks while writing it on paper speak whatever you are writing so they check verbally if we are doing it right or wrong and help if we are making any mistake. She asked me the difference between drop, delete and truncate? Then she moved to the DSA section and two coding questions were asked in this round. 1. Reverse a linked list 2. Remove duplicates from a string. She asked me to discuss the approaches then code it and then discuss the time complexity. Some questions related to OOPS. Then she asked me some questions related to the Hackathon I mentioned and a few of the achievements that I mentioned. At last I asked her some questions like how is her experience at DB ? How are projects allocated to the new joiners? Professional Fitness Round (approx 25 - 30 mins) The interview begins with the introduced yourself question. Next the interviewer asked how has been your day so far. How were your previous rounds of interview? Afterwards there was a brief discussion about the internship experience. After the internship experience, the interviewer moved on to the projects section. He asked to explain the first project mentioned. Then some follow up questions about the project. Then he said your project name is quite unique so could explain its meaning and how it resonates with your topic. He then asked what is GAuth and why have you used it ? Then he asked to draw the database diagram for the first project. Why have I used mongodb? He asked what is the primary key and foreign key? Then he asked me to explain the second project which was related to ML. So some follow up questions from where do you get the dataset? Why did you select the particular dataset? What are the criteria on which it depends? What is CNN? What is SVC (support vector classifier ) and logistic regression ? Then he asked what Data structures are ? Explain them in brief and their operations. Next I was asked to code - print nth Fibonacci Number in c++. Explain the approach and the code and discuss the time complexity. He then asked about the Pride Hack , MLH which I mentioned in the resume and discussion about the experience, learnings from it and what the project was all about. Then he asked where do you stay ? How do you travel daily and why did you choose VJTI ? Has your 7th semester started ? What were your subjects for 6 th sem ? and what subjects do you have in 7th sem ? So, do you have any plans for higher studies to which I replied NO. There was a situation based question where I was asked what if you just joined a team and the team is changing their mainframe so for that reason you need to work in shifts and sometimes after office hours. How will you deal with this situation? Then he asked some family background questions to get to know more about the individual. What is your location preference ? and some questions why this location and not the other one. Do you know where the DB office is located in Mumbai? Why do you want to join DB ? At last he said you are doing good and asked me if I have any questions for him. So I asked what are the tech stack used in DB ? and how is his experience with DB? HR Round (Approx 20 - 30 mins) How was your day so far? Introduce yourself. Next the interviewer asked questions related to internship experience. Then questions related to projects which include why you select the particular project topic ? How is yourself learning from working in a team ? One of the projects was individual, then what are the difficulties faced and how you decide on a particular tech stack. Which language do you prefer C++ or Python ? Some questions related to it. How will you describe yourself ? Where do you see yourself in the next 5 years ? What are your weaknesses ? Why do you want to join Deutsche Bank ? Do you have any questions for me ? After all the 4 rounds the result was declared , 26 students were selected and I was one of them. TIPS : Be thorough with your resume. Mention the things that you have complete knowledge about so that you can answer all the cross questions about the project functionality and tech stacks used. Have a calm and relaxed mind on the day of your interview. Believe in yourself that you have prepared with a plan and are gonna answer all the questions with confidence. Most importantly don’t lose hope till the last moment. Speak out loud and don’t be silent if you don’t know any answer. Try giving your best for each and every question that is being asked. Have patience and listen to the interviewer properly if you need any more clarification then do ask questions don’t hesitate. Communication is the key. After going through all the interview experiences you will definitely get an idea about the most asked questions. So be prepared for some answers beforehand so that you can answer them with ease. Participate in hackathons, do some group projects which will show your ability to work in a group and that's how the corporate even works. Try giving some mock interviews . Use some online resources like pramp , interviewbit or ask your friends, seniors or connect with people on linkedin. There are people out there who can help you with their experience and it even helps you to build a good network and improve your communication skills. All the very best !! If you have any queries , feel free to drop an email at tambeshruti241@gmail.com or connect over linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/in/shruti-tambe-727657228/.
